scope: Installed listener composition with synthetic signed provider controls; no real Linear, ngrok, model or complete M2/LINK-01 acceptance.

cases.IR01: Explicit private sealed receiver configuration accepts only supported route, webhook, secret file, loopback port and finite lifetime; unknown fields, bad values and changed sources refuse.
cases.IR02: Actual installed CLI starts one loopback listener and wakes existing inbound processing after durable signed intake; task query sees the resulting existing Core policy state.
cases.IR03: Wrong signature, organization/webhook scope, method, route, duplicate headers, malformed JSON and body/header bounds refuse without an applied task effect; legitimate unrelated issues retain only existing minimal ignored metadata.
cases.IR04: Slow/partial reads and exhausted concurrency remain bounded; acknowledgement waits only for durable intake and never provider readback. Late callback work remains owned until settled.
cases.IR05: Restart drains durable received work and waits for an existing delivery lease expiry; duplicate delivery does not duplicate an applied effect.
cases.IR06: A second owner or occupied port refuses without stopping the first owner or an unrelated listener; owner lock identity replacement refuses.
cases.IR07: Startup/drain failure, session revocation/expiration, changed configuration/credential/secret and termination stop admission and report actual bounded cleanup. Unknown live work is not called stopped. Require the existing signed installed enrollment; validate current provider binding once during bounded startup and check local enrollment expiry/revocation on intake and drain. A valid Core capability alone does not authorize an expired listener.
cases.IR08: Installed source/package bindings and supported command are retained; existing affected submit/enqueue/interface checks remain valid. Runtime imports no tests, arbitrary import or transport override from operator data.

history: Version 1 local and installed controls passed but did not establish signed enrollment expiry; version 2 explicitly connects existing session enrollment validation.
